questions.question: In a certain code language, 'nu vu du' is written as 'Time and Money', 'hu du ru' is written as 'Manage Money Judiciously', and 'tu vu lu' is written as 'Save More Time'. What is the code for 'Save More Money' in that code language?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

'nu vu du' is written as 'Time and Money', 

'hu du ru' is written as 'Manage Money Judiciously', 

'tu vu lu' is written as 'Save More Time'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba63074bc1d23ff574eda555879195d289533a45f7d47d7e2846cb44b89d97fb.png] 

Here,

'Save' and 'More' will be coded as either 'tu' or 'lu'.

'Money' will be coded as 'du'.

So, 'Save More Money' will be coded as 'tu lu du'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. No car is a bench.

II. All tables are cars.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cars are tables.

II. Some cars are benches.

III. No bench is a table.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Statements:

I. No car is a bench.

II. All tables are cars.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c56aa8ee214c0cf750d8110024499bd51b0a0df1f208577f664ddacd7d87df2.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) Some cars are tables - True (Because All tables are cars).

(ii) Some cars are benches - False (Because No car is a bench).

(iii) No bench is a table - **True **(Because All tables are Car and No car is a bench, so no bench is table).

Here, Only conclusion I and III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

(18, 400, 484)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**1st number;**

**(1st number + 2)² = 2nd number;**

**(1st number + 4)2 = 3rd number;**

Now, 

(18, 400, 484)

18, (18 + 2)², (18 + 4)2

= 18, (20)2, (22)2 → (18, 400, 484);

Similarly, for **(24, 676, 784)**

**24, (24 + 2)2, (24 + 4)2**

**= 24, (26)2, (28)2 → (24, 676, 784)**.

So, (24, 676, 784) is related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

questions.question:
After interchanging the given two signs + and – and two numbers 6 and 25, what will be the value of the given expression?

4 – 6 ÷ 5 × 25 + 14
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation: 4 – 6 ÷ 5 × 25 + 14

Now, if '+ and –' and '6 and 25' are interchanged, then:

⇒ 4 + __**25 ÷ 5**__ × 6 - 14

⇒ 4 + __**5 × 6**__ - 14

⇒ 4 + 30 - 14

⇒ 34 - 14 = 20.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
